summary: Limoneira Company's subsidiary, Windfall Investors, LLC, entered into a Purchase and Sale Agreement on August 15, 2026, to sell five vineyard properties totaling approximately 724 acres in Paso Robles, California, to Paul Rusnak and permitted assigns for $15,000,000. This sale follows a terminated sale of the same properties and aligns with Limoneira's strategy to monetize non-core real estate. The buyer made a 12% earnest money deposit; the deal resulted from a Concierge Auctions public auction and closing is scheduled no later than September 14, 2026. The agreement is not conditioned on financing or due diligence. The buyer excluded the 2026 harvest, so the seller retains related revenues and access through November 30, 2026. Seller reps are capped at 3% of the purchase price. Watch for closing completion and any changes to the rental agreements.
